text: A client sends one DNS query for the A record of attack0.home.lan to the resolver 127.0.0.1 on UDP port 53.
source_text: 1. The attacker's client sent one DNS query for the A record of attack0.home.lan to the resolver at 127.0.0.1.

text: The resolver 127.0.0.1 sends 46 DNS queries, an A and an AAAA query for each of 23 names ns<N>.fake<N>.fake0, to 127.0.0.2.
source_text: For each of them the resolver asked the authoritative server 127.0.0.2 for both an A and an AAAA record. In this capture it resolved 23 such names, from ns28.fake28.fake0 to ns51.fake51.fake0, sending 46 queries.

text: 127.0.0.2 answers each A query with the address 127.0.0.89 and a referral to a.root-servers.net at 127.0.0.2.
source_text: Every A query was answered with the address 127.0.0.89 together with a referral to the root (a.root-servers.net at 127.0.0.2); every AAAA query was answered with no address, only an SOA record.

text: 127.0.0.2 answers each AAAA query with no address record, only an SOA record.
source_text: Every A query was answered with the address 127.0.0.89 together with a referral to the root (a.root-servers.net at 127.0.0.2); every AAAA query was answered with no address, only an SOA record.

text: The resolver sends two DNS NS queries for the root zone to 127.0.0.2.
source_text: The resolver also re-checked the root name servers twice with NS queries.

text: The resolver 127.0.0.1 sends 28 DNS queries for attack0.home.lan to 127.0.0.89 on UDP port 53.
source_text: It sent 28 such queries, and each one immediately bounced with an ICMP "port unreachable" message because nothing listens on port 53 at that address.

text: 127.0.0.89 answers each of those queries with an ICMP destination unreachable (port unreachable) message.
source_text: It sent 28 such queries, and each one immediately bounced with an ICMP "port unreachable" message because nothing listens on port 53 at that address.

text: After 0.72 seconds the resolver returns a DNS SERVFAIL response to the client.
source_text: 4. After 0.72 seconds the resolver stopped and answered the client with a DNS SERVFAIL response.

text: Two one-byte UDP datagrams are sent from the loopback host to itself.
source_text: The resolver also exchanged two one-byte UDP datagrams with itself on loopback at the start of the capture, which are internal wake-up signals rather than attack traffic.
